description: The BaRAD GitHub repository provides scripts associated with bias adjusting global radiation fields and an accessible copy of the generated dataset. The Scientific Data article connects the code to monthly total, diffuse and direct shortwave components derived from MERRA-2 and station observations. A modeller could inspect its data preparation before adapting solar-resource or land-surface forcing to another period. The machine-learning correction is trained on the available observation network; it should not be assumed equally accurate where stations are sparse. The code is a research workflow, not a continuously updated forecast service. GitHub reports CC BY 4.0 for repository content. I read own metadata and README without cloning or running scripts. The related PANGAEA BaRAD release is reviewed separately as the persistent data deposit. No exact catalogue code record was found.
